# MCP Development Backlog

This document tracks MCP tools for editor features that already exist in Babylon.js Editor but are not yet exposed through the MCP server. It is an MCP coverage record, not a claim of full Unity-style editor UI parity; use `UNITY-6-5-PARITY.md` for the product-parity status.

Status meanings:

- **Completion**: implemented and build/format verified.
- **Testing**: live MCP exercise where available, otherwise the stated automated test coverage. It does not imply full Unity-style editor UI parity.

Latest completed increment:

- **#584 — Exact field-selective De-Interlace PSD smart filter.** Completion: Complete. Testing: Complete. Real writer ID/class `1148089458`/`Dntr` preserves exact Odd/Even Lines elimination and Duplication/Interpolation reconstruction. `bounded-field-reconstruction-de-interlace-smart-filter-v1` deterministically reconstructs the selected one-based field parity from a retained neighbor or surrounding-line average while preserving destination alpha, clearing transparent RGB, and enforcing the work ceiling; it does not claim Photoshop pixel identity.
